p1: At 3 a.m., Daniel's smart speaker started laughing in the dark.
He lives alone. The speaker runs his whole house.
It even turns the lights on in whatever room he walks into.
He checked the app. One voice request, whispered at 3:02.
He scrolled back. The same whisper, every night.
And every night, the speaker answered.
The laugh was a test. To see if he'd wake up.
Tonight, Daniel waited on the couch in the dark.
At 3 a.m., the hallway light turned on.
Then the lounge light. Then the lamp right beside him.
